items.title: Importance of Equivalence in Logic (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Importance of Equivalence in Logic (PDF 30, printed 26).

blocks.text: Equivalence is liye aham hai ke yeh logic ke masle aasan banati hai. Is se hum mushkil expression ki jagah aasan expression rakh sakte hain, jis se waqt aur mehnat bachti hai. Programming mein equivalent (aasan) expressions code ko zyada efficient (kam kaam mein behtar) banate hain. Equivalence logical ghaltiyon se bachati hai aur sahi reasoning aur sahi faisle yaqeeni banati hai. Yeh concept maths aur computer science dono mein kaam aata hai aur logical soch ko mazboot karta hai.

items: Mushkil expression ki jagah aasan barabar expression: waqt aur mehnat ki bachat.
Code efficient hota hai aur logical ghaltiyan kam hoti hain.
